blurb:
Families from all over the world trust us for the ultimate family adventure — a private guided desert hike. Explore the Sonoran Desert with us and see interesting rock formations, canyons, mountain peaks, cactus forests and giant saguaros. 

*** Our special offer for guided hike for families. Kids under 10 are alway FREE! Plus, reduced youth pricing for ages 11-17. *** 

We guide a variety of trails suitable for all ages and skill levels. Whether you have toddlers or teens, our hikes are designed to be engaging and accessible. Guides are knowledgeable about the local flora, fauna, geology and history of the Sonoran Desert of Arizona. Kids and teens will love learning about desert wildlife, unique plants and the stunning rock formations. 

All guided hikes are led by pro, expert guides trained in trail safety, first aid and CPR, ensuring a worry-free adventure. From the iconic saguaro cacti to panoramic mountain views, our hikes offer picture-perfect moments you’ll cherish forever.
